content: Do not be proud of wealth, kin, or youth; time sweeps them away in the blink of an eye. Free yourself from illusion.
author: Adi Shankara
explanation:
In the uncompromising architecture of Advaita Vedanta, Adi Shankara reveals that non-dual consciousness is the eternal reality behind all fleeting phenomena.

This teaching (Do not be proud of wealth, kin, or youth; time sweeps them a...) focuses directly on proud and wealth. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on proud today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper proud and wealth in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
